threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the Tube' instead of just 'overground' when you hop on at London Fields. Locals know it’s just the quick route.
Heard a lad on the 196 confess he’s never been to the Brixton Windmill, swearing he’ll go next weekend. Good luck with that!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a grumpy old man feeding pigeons while chatting with a breakdancer in the park. That's Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a 24-hour Döner place that serves breakfast burritos with curry sauce. You won't find that combo anywhere else.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know a local when they can effortlessly navigate BART delays while non-locals just stare at their phones, waiting for updates that never come.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo on the 14 Mission, casually scrolling his phone. Only in SF would you dress to the nines for a Friday night out but still ride the bus.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think we all love 'aqua de Valencia.' Most of us prefer a simple vermut with olives at midday, way more authentic.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You'll spot them by their hesitant approach to the metro. They often miss the right exit because they're too busy scanning their maps instead of the signs.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still avoid the buskers on Kingsland Road? Nah, you gotta learn to embrace the soundtrack of Dalston.
I once saw a guy on the 59 bus argue with his phone for ten minutes, then casually order a takeaway like it was the most normal thing ever.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw a kid selling handmade lemonade on Sonnenallee, yelling '1 Euro for the secret recipe!' with the sun setting behind him.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You ever notice how the U-Bahn stations here have names that sound like poetry? Warschauer Straße and Schlesisches Tor. They're like musical stops on your commute.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a true local knows the real reason the food trucks park at the same spot every Friday—it's the unofficial taco war meet-up.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full suit and tie eating a burrito while simultaneously reading a novel on Muni. Only in San Francisco do style and chaos coexist like that.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists flock to the plaça, but miss the old bookshops hidden in the alleys. They're like treasure chests, full of stories and history.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by the way they still carry a map in their hands, looking up bewildered at the corners of the Plaça del Sol.
